title: NFTPass
tagline: Create Wallet passes for your NFT collection so you can more easily
description: This project allows you to create wallet passes using Apple passkit API. You can have your NFT collection holders mint these passes in order for them to get into events, premium locations, etc.. These passes disappear when the nft gets transferred from your address, and can hold realtime parameters if needed like balance, and much more.
how_its_made:
I used Express for the server that serves the passes and makes sure that the owner actually owns an nft by making them sign a request and then sending that request to the server. I used NextJs for the frontend. I also used SIWE (Sign-in-with-etheruem) standard. 

https://nftpass-frontend.vercel.app/
